inferenceRules: Static payload profiles test mechanics; adaptive profiles may switch only from observer-safe Firm-track combat assessment, never hidden defender values.
A shield-specialist must materially improve cumulative progress against Shield-heavy targets but lose to GP/penetrator on no-Shield or Armor/Hull-focused lanes to justify selectable status.
A Kinetic selectable mode must win a genuine niche and lose another; if it strictly dominates the contemporary GP package, prefer automatic upgrade instead.
Movement-order mirrors are retained, but known TL7/TL9 Kinetic-vs-Missile cliff lanes are not used as payload-balance promotion gates.
PDS-present and PDS-removed target profiles are both included so interception does not mask payload effect.
No payload profile in CP114 changes CP109/CP110 candidate tables or production C#/Godot runtime.
